Interface ExecutionRepository

All Superinterfaces:
org.springframework.data.repository.CrudRepository<Execution, UUID>, org.springframework.data.jpa.repository.JpaRepository<Execution, UUID>, org.springframework.data.repository.ListCrudRepository<Execution, UUID>, org.springframework.data.repository.ListPagingAndSortingRepository<Execution, UUID>, org.springframework.data.repository.PagingAndSortingRepository<Execution, UUID>, org.springframework.data.repository.query.QueryByExampleExecutor<Execution>, org.springframework.data.repository.Repository<Execution, UUID>
@Repository public interface ExecutionRepository extends org.springframework.data.jpa.repository.JpaRepository<Execution, UUID>
Repository interface for managing Execution entities. Provides methods to perform CRUD operations and custom queries on executions.
